notes.title: Patch 3.2087.1 (Added Russian)
notes.notes:
Been quite some time now, but here's yet another Envelope update! This time the focus was on adding a Russian translation, with the help of some amazing people. It required a bit of work with the UI elements, but everything should work as intended.

As a bonus, I added some extra stuff just for fun, including a couple of extra secrets. Enjoy!

3.2087.1 changelist

General
[list]
[*] Added the Russian language.
[*] Added more secrets.
[/list]

Part 2 (Stendal)
[list]
[*] Added a little more furniture to Reba 50 storage room.
[*] Added some textures on the automatic doors inside Reba 50 to make it more easy to find the way in and out of the store.
[*] Made a few changes to Lil Rascat's family house.
[*] Interacting with the fuse box now requires you to equip a key or screwdriver, to avoid activating the event by accident.
[/list]

Part 3 (The mansion)
[list]
[*] Made some additional doors unlocked by default.
[*] Added a lever that can be activated to disable the alarm system.
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] To have more flexibility with multiple languages, some of the UI elements have been modified to scale based on the length of the text.
[*] Some items, like lockpicks and bullets, will have the quantity displayed even if you have just one of them. This is to attempt to make it more obvious that they are one time use.
[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*] You should now be able to kill the duck properly with any weapon.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.1256.0 (Localization)
notes.notes:
We are working on localization tools which will enable us to add translations to the UI and dialogue. The translation files are in the works, and will be added to the game the upcoming weeks!

We also added some information about the alarm system in the mansion level that you can find in the guard shack, and we did some minor adjustments to the guard AI.

notes.title: Patch 3.1251.0
notes.notes:
We've been monitoring gameplay videos after release and we made some changes to make the experience even more comfortable. We added an auto-skip feature that unlocks when you have already seen a certain dialogue. The auto-skip will automatically skip past dialogue super quickly until the end, or until dialogue options are reached. No more spam-clicking through dialogue!

We also fixed a few bugs, and we made some small graphics changes.

General
[list]
[*]Added an auto-skip button for dialogue you have already seen.
[/list]

Part 2
[list]
[*]Added Truck Driver Johnson to Reba 50.
[*]Moved the dirt patch on the other side of the fixable bridge.
[*]Made some changes to the dialogue of the guy at the forest tunnel.
[*]Made some changes to the dialogue of the guy behind the stage in Stendal camping.
[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*]The player can no longer move during cutscenes.
[*]Fixed the bug that allowed the player to move while the PC UI was still displaying.
[/list]

notes.title: Going full release!
notes.notes:
With this new patch, Envelope is leaving early access and entering full release!

3.1248.1 changelist

General
[list]
[*]Added a journal that the player can use to write down things they need to memorize. Also allows for drawing, allowing the player to draw a map of the world.
[*]Added the Void, an area that appears when the player gets their first ending, and when they complete all the tasks of the game. This server as the true ending of the game.
[/list]

Part 2
[list]
[*]Added mushrooms that can be eaten. These give various boosts, like stamina, or the ability to survive toxic gas.
[*]New NPCs
[list]
[*]The forager. He gives you information about mushrooms, as well as having a challenge tied to him.
[*]Tunneler. A simple NPC that stands near the tunnel and tells the player that the tunnel can't be entered, even if they use dynamite.
[*]Gunnhaug. She stands outside a house in Slepnir Drive. Gives you free soda cans you can use for punting.
[/list]
[*]Added a way to make a shortcut from the spawnpoint to Stendal camping to save time.
[*]Added a bridge in Stendal camping that can be repaired.
[*]Added extra interactions with the cat lady at the end of Sleipnir Drive.
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*]Added extra info on the endings screen.
[*]Added a link to the Envelope wiki on the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1199.1
notes.notes:
2.1199.1 changelist

General
[list]
[*]New/updated textures for items.
[list]
[*]Lockpick.
[*]Shovel.
[*]Money.
[*]Sledge hammer.[/list]
[*]The player can now tap shift to sprint, instead of holding it down. If the player stop moving, sprint will be turned off. A lot of players are saving their stamina by instinct, but there is no punishment by letting the stamina run out. If you sprint when the stamina has run out, you will still move more quickly than if you just walk. This change will hopefully make it more intuitive!
[*]Crouch is now toggle by default.
[*]Added a "safer language" setting, that replaces some swear words. This has not been perfected yet![/list]

Part 2
[list]
[*]Added a secret cave in the tunnel between Stendal camping and the forest. 
[*]The conspiracy theorist now has a quest that can be completed to get a grappling hook.
[*]Added a way to enter the bathroom in Reba 50.
[*]Moldy Noldy now disappears when you walk too far away from him at the beginning of the playthrough.[/list]

Part 3
[list]
[*]Added a hedge outside the glass house.
[*]New texture to the bunker door.
[*]Selecting "no" on Mistashur's dialogue now allows you to just leave the level. This gives a unique ending.
[*]There are now more variables to Mistashur's dialogue.
[*]Killing Mistashur now gives you a visible effect. This is due to Michael being "blooded".
[*]Added a fire escape ladder near the glass house, that can be used as an entrance to the mansion.
[*]Guard dogs can now be killed with a sledge hammer or axe.[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*]The Roleplayer challenge can now be completed.
[*]The Roleplayer challenge now works properly in the forest dweller dialogue.
[*]Guard dogs should now be easier to hit with gunshots.
[*]You can no longer throw items through the glass house from the outside.
[*]Amount of endings sometimes got stuck at 3/6.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1196.0
notes.notes:
2.1196.0 changelist

Part 2
[list]
[*]Several NPCs now have dialogue that reminds you of the task they gave to you if you talk to them more than once.
[*]Added a few more dirt mounds.
[/list]

General
[list]
[*]Doors now have less durability, allowing you to destroy them a bit faster with both the sledge hammer, and the axe. 
[list]
[*]Sledge hammer hits required: 8 -> 3
[*]Axe hits required: 4 -> 2
[*]Doors can also now be blown up with explosives.[/list]
[*]The sledge hammer and axe now have a hit marker on the screen to more easily see where you have to aim to hit anything.
[*]The sledge hammer and axe also have a sound indicator when you swing it.
[*]Fixed a few spelling errors, as well as changed up some of the dialogue to give more context and character to Michael.
[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*]The sledge hammer and axe should now work on the teens outside Reba 50.
[*]The game should no longer freeze after you hear the gunshot in part 1.
[*]You can now walk up the stairs at the house in the farm.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1195.0
notes.notes:
2.2195.0 changelist

Part 2
[list]
[*]Moldy Noldy now gives you an energy drink on your first playthrough.
[*]Added an easy way to earn money in Reba 50, using a machine that converts empty soda cans into money.
[*]Added two new NPCs
[list]
[*]Man near Punt machine in Reba.
[*]Man behind stage in Stendal camping.[/list]
[*]Added street signs.
[*]Reworked energy drinks to temporarily allow you to sprint for a longer duration.
[*]Added a vignette effect when taking hyperfixation pills.
[*]Moved the shovel to a more appropriate location.
[*]The farmer now gives you a gas can after you blow up the tractor.
[*]Water bucket lady now gives you carrots, that give a small energy boost.
[*]Lyle's mother now points you in the direction of her son if you take Yahn Robin's quest.
[/list]
Part 3
[list]
[*]The guard dogs now eat the steak for a longer duration.
[/list]
Notes
[list]
[*]We watched some streamers play the game, and felt that our way of communicating objectives was a bit too weak, so we've made some changes to make everything more clear. We felt that by keeping the game open ended, it would incentivise exploration, but instead people felt aimless. Finding the right boundary between letting the player explore, and giving them guidance was a bit hard to find. Also, instead of hiding essential gameplay mechanics, they should be given to the player, and more optional mechanics/items can be more hidden.
[/list]
